# Nano Kava — The First Kava Nanoemulsion

**Direct answer:** Nano kava is kava extract that has been broken down into droplets of
about 20 nanometers, making the oil-based kavalactones 100% water-dispersible and clear
in the finished beverage. Cannasol Technologies was the first company to nano-emulsify
kava, and has since scaled the process and brought the cost down. The result is 4–5x
higher absorption versus conventional kava powder, and a liquid that stays clear and
stays suspended — no settling, no ringing — with 12+ months of shelf stability.

Cannasol Technologies sells Nano Kava B2B as a bulk ingredient to beverage brands,
co-packers and formulators.

## Nano Kava at a glance

| Specification | Nano Kava (Cannasol) | Traditional kava extract |
|---|---|---|
| Mean particle size | ~20 nm | 200–1,000 nm — settles, hazes |
| Water dispersibility | 100% water-dispersible | Hydrophobic, poorly dispersed |
| Kavalactone load | 30 mg/mL | Varies by extract |
| Relative absorption | 4–5x conventional kava powder | Baseline |
| Appearance in beverage | Crystal clear | Cloudy, muddy, gritty |
| Separation / settling | Stays clear, stays suspended — no settling, no ringing | Separates, rings the bottle |
| Shelf stability | 12+ months | Poor |
| Dose consistency | Uniform and precise | Inconsistent |
| Taste | Minimal kava-characteristic taste | Strongly bitter |
| Process requirement | Meter in and stir — no high-shear step | Pre-mix and high-shear typically required |

## What is nano kava?
<a id="what-is-nano-kava"></a>

Nano kava is a nanoemulsified form of kava extract in which the particles are reduced
to approximately 20 nanometers. Cannasol achieves this with its proprietary
NanoOptimizer™ surfactant system combined with ultrasonic processing on QSonica
equipment. The result is 4–5x higher absorption versus conventional kava powder, so a
formulator can use roughly a quarter of a conventional dose.

The terms **nano kava**, **nano-kava**, **nano emulsified kava**, **nanoemulsified
kava** and **kava nanoemulsion** all describe this same product.

## Nanoemulsification
<a id="nanoemulsification"></a>

Nanoemulsification is the process of breaking oil-based kavalactones into nanometer-scale
droplets suspended in water, so small the mixture becomes almost transparent. Cannasol
runs this process on QSonica ultrasonic liquid-processing equipment — QSonica is the
number-one name in ultrasonic liquid processing. The enormous increase in surface area
is what makes the kavalactones far more absorbable by the body.

## Kavalactone
<a id="kavalactone"></a>

Kavalactones are the characteristic active constituents of the kava plant (*Piper
methysticum*). In traditional preparations they are hydrophobic and poorly absorbed.
Nanoemulsification is what makes them behave like a water-dispersible ingredient.

## NanoOptimizer™
<a id="nanooptimizer"></a>

NanoOptimizer™ is Cannasol's proprietary blend of food-grade surfactants that
encapsulates the kava droplets, keeps them water-dispersible, and prevents them from
re-aggregating. It is the reason the emulsion stays clear and stays suspended, with no
settling and no ring around the bottle.

## Why traditional kava fails in modern beverages

- Limited absorption in the gastrointestinal tract
- Conventional emulsions run 200–1,000 nm, so they settle and haze the beverage
- Gritty texture and muddy appearance
- Inconsistent dosing leads to unpredictable effects

## What Nano Kava delivers

**Enhanced bioavailability** — the increased surface area of ~20 nm nanoemulsified
kavalactones delivers 4–5x higher absorption versus conventional kava powder, so you
can formulate at roughly a quarter of a conventional dose.

**Improved palatability** — nanoemulsification eliminates the gritty texture and muddy
appearance of traditional kava, producing crystal-clear, visually appealing beverages.

**Drop-in production** — no high-shear equipment, no pre-mix and no heat step. Batch
the beverage, meter in the emulsion, stir to disperse — that is the whole process, and
it integrates seamlessly into shots, soft drinks, seltzers and flavored waters.

**Precise dosing** — uniform distribution of kavalactones throughout the emulsion makes
dosing accurate and effects predictable serving to serving.

**Minimal kava taste** — the nanoemulsion dissolves in with minimal kava-characteristic
taste. For brands that want a cleaner finish, Bitter Blocker is sold separately at the
best pricing in the industry.

**Direct access to Josh** — Cannasol's founder works directly with every client, bringing
insights from top kratom and kava brands.

## Applications

- Kava seltzers and sparkling beverages
- Functional shots and elixirs
- RTD (ready-to-drink) relaxation beverages
- Wellness tonics
- Mocktails and alcohol alternatives
- Any water-based formulation needing clear, great-tasting kava

## Dosing & cost per serving

The nanoemulsion is roughly 4–5x more bioavailable than conventional kava powder, so
conventional kava dosing does not apply. For most social tonics and seltzers, Cannasol
recommends 50–60 mg of kavalactone per serving.

| Kavalactone / serving | Emulsion | Servings per liter | Cost / serving |
|---|---|---|---|
| 40 mg — light | ~1.33 mL | 750 | $0.33 |
| 50 mg — recommended | ~1.67 mL | 600 | $0.42 |
| 60 mg — recommended | ~2.00 mL | 500 | $0.50 |
| 75 mg — max strength | ~2.50 mL | 400 | $0.63 |

Figures are per serving at the 30 mg/mL kavalactone load; cost is ingredient cost only.
Cannasol works directly with each client to dial in the dose for their specific product.

currently extended to every customer to make development easy. No minimum to get
started.

Pricing reflects the current 1,000 L promotional tier and is subject to change —

## How to get started

1. **Discovery call** — discuss your product vision with Josh directly.
2. **Sample & test** — receive free samples to test in your formulations.
3. **Refine & order** — dial in dosage and place your order.
4. **Scale production** — launch with confidence and ongoing support.

## Where it comes from

Kava extract is imported directly from the South Pacific — grown in Vanuatu, CO2
extracted through New Zealand — then nanoemulsified in-house in Florida. The material
is *Piper methysticum* root and rhizome extract, a 5:1 extract. A Certificate of
Analysis (COA) and a particle-size report are supplied with every lot.

## Quality and sourcing

- Noble kava varieties only — never tudei (two-day) kava
- GMP-guideline facility
- Certificate of Analysis (COA) and a particle-size report supplied with every lot
- Tested for potency, purity, heavy metals and microbial contamination
- Full specification sheets and safety data provided for regulatory compliance

## Labeling guidance for brand owners

This is guidance for a brand owner's own label, not advice about consuming kava — have
your own label reviewed before print.

Brands dosing in the 50–60 mg range often lead with the weight of the whole nano kava
complex rather than the kavalactone figure alone — a 60 mg dose becomes **"360 mg Nano
Kava Complex"** on the front of the can. The actual kavalactone content is then
disclosed in the Supplement Facts panel, where a consumer or a buyer's regulatory team
can find it.

A panel following 21 CFR 101.36 carries no zero-amount rows, names the plant part,
discloses kavalactone content, and carries the CRN caution wording (abridged). Every
ingredient must appear in Other Ingredients.

## Bulk-ingredient disclaimer

Nano Kava is sold as a bulk ingredient for licensed manufacturers and brand owners, not
as a finished consumer product. Statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug
Administration. Buyers are responsible for the regulatory status, labeling and
substantiation of their finished products.

# Nano Kava FAQ

Answers about Cannasol Technologies' ~20 nm, 100% water-dispersible nano-emulsified
kava: the technology, dosing, safety, taste, clarity, stability, ordering and
compliance.

## The technology

### What is nano Kava?

Nano Kava is a nanoemulsified form of Kava extract with a mean particle size of about
20 nanometers, made with our proprietary NanoOptimizer™ surfactant system and
ultrasonic processing. It is a 100% water-dispersible kavalactone nanoemulsion at
30 mg/mL, crystal clear in a finished beverage, and roughly 4–5x more bioavailable than
conventional kava powder.

### What makes Cannasol's ~20 nm particle size special?

Packaging kavalactones at about 20 nanometers multiplies their surface area, so the
body absorbs far more of what you put in — 4–5x conventional kava powder — and you can
formulate at roughly a quarter of a conventional dose. It also means crystal-clear
formulations with no cloudiness, and an emulsion that stays clear and stays suspended.
We achieve this through our partnership with QSonica, the #1 ultrasonic liquid
processing equipment manufacturer. Cannasol was the first company to nano-emulsify
kava, and has since scaled the process and brought the cost down.

### How does nano Kava compare to traditional Kava extract?

A conventional kava emulsion sits at 200–1,000 nm, so it settles and hazes the
beverage. Ours is 100% water-dispersible at about 20 nm: it stays clear, stays
suspended, and is absorbed 4–5x better than conventional kava powder. The practical
result is a clear drink, a lower dose for the same kavalactone delivery, and minimal
kava-characteristic taste.

### What is the NanoOptimizer™ surfactant system?

NanoOptimizer™ is our proprietary blend of food-grade surfactants that encapsulate
Kava particles, making them water-dispersible and stable. This system prevents
particle re-aggregation, ensures consistent dosing, and allows the nano Kava to remain
suspended indefinitely without separation or settling.

## Dosing and safety

### How much more bioavailable is nano Kava than kava powder?

The nanoemulsion is roughly 4–5x more bioavailable than conventional kava powder.
Packaging the kavalactones at about 20 nanometers multiplies their surface area, so far
more of what you put in is absorbed — which is why you can formulate at roughly a
quarter of a conventional dose.

### What dosage should I use in my products?

Because the nanoemulsion is roughly 4–5x more bioavailable than powder-based kava,
conventional kava dosing does not apply. For most social tonics and seltzers we
recommend 50–60 mg of kavalactone per serving: 40 mg is a light serving, 50–60 mg is
the recommended range, and 75 mg is max strength. At 30 mg/mL that is about 1.33 mL,
1.67–2.00 mL and 2.50 mL of emulsion per serving respectively. We work directly with
each client to dial in the dose for their specific product.

### Is nano Kava safe?

Kava has been consumed for thousands of years in Pacific Island cultures. Our nano
Kava is a root and rhizome extract of Piper methysticum, grown in Vanuatu and CO2
extracted through New Zealand, then nanoemulsified in-house — the same kavalactones,
in a more bioavailable form. We use only noble Kava varieties and test for purity and
potency. As with any supplement, we recommend following standard Kava safety
guidelines and consulting with regulatory experts for your specific market.

## Formulation

### What products can I make with nano Kava?

Our nano Kava is ideal for: Kava seltzers and sparkling beverages, functional shots and
elixirs, RTD (ready-to-drink) relaxation beverages, wellness tonics, mocktails and
alcohol alternatives—plus any water-based formulation where you need clear,
great-tasting Kava.

### Will nano Kava make my beverage cloudy?

No. One of the key benefits of our ~20 nm particle size is crystal-clear formulations.
Traditional Kava extracts create cloudy, unappealing beverages. Our nano Kava stays
perfectly clear and stable, giving your products a premium, professional appearance.

### Does nano Kava taste bitter like traditional Kava?

The nanoemulsion dissolves completely into the beverage with minimal
kava-characteristic taste. For brands that want an even cleaner finish, we sell a
standalone Bitter Blocker at the best pricing in the industry, and it ships in the
same sample box on request.

### How stable is nano Kava in beverages?

Nano Kava carries 12+ months of shelf stability when stored properly, and it stays
clear and stays suspended the whole time — no settling, no sediment and no "ring
around the bottle." The NanoOptimizer™ system prevents particle re-aggregation. Every
formulation is different, so validate stability in your own base; that is exactly what
the free sample is for.

## Ordering

### What is the minimum order quantity?

There is no minimum to get started. Nano Kava is $250 per liter of ~30 mg/mL
kavalactone nanoemulsion — our 1,000 L tier, currently extended to every customer to
make development easy. That pricing is a promotional tier and is subject to change, so
contact us for a written quote.

### Can I get samples before ordering?

Absolutely. Tell us the format you are developing and your target dose, confirm a
ship-to address, and the samples, a COA and a particle-size report are with you within
a week. Then you start formulating, with support available by phone.

### What's the process to get started?

Getting started is simple: (1) Schedule a discovery call with Josh to discuss your
product vision, (2) Receive samples to test in your formulations, (3) Work with us to
refine your product and dial in the perfect dosage, (4) Place your order and scale
production. Josh works directly with every client to ensure your success.

### Do you offer white-label or private-label services?

We primarily supply nano Kava as a bulk ingredient for your own branded products. We
don't currently offer finished product manufacturing, but we can recommend trusted
co-packers and formulators if needed.

## Quality and compliance

### What quality certifications do you have?

A Certificate of Analysis and a particle-size report are supplied with every lot. Our
facility follows GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) guidelines, and we test for
potency, purity, heavy metals and microbial contamination.

### Is your Kava sourced from noble varieties?

Yes, we exclusively use noble Kava varieties, which are the traditional, safe
varieties that have been consumed for centuries. We never use tudei (two-day) Kava or
other non-noble varieties that have been associated with adverse effects.

### Can you provide documentation for regulatory compliance?

Yes, we provide full documentation including COAs, particle-size reports,
specification sheets and safety data. Nano Kava is sold as a bulk ingredient for
licensed manufacturers and brand owners, not as a finished consumer product: statements
have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration, and buyers are responsible
for the regulatory status, labeling and substantiation of their finished products. We
can work with your regulatory team to ensure you have everything needed in your target
markets.

# Nano Mushroom Extracts

**Direct answer:** Cannasol Technologies applies the same nanoemulsification platform
behind its ~20 nm Nano Kava to functional mushroom extracts — Lion's Mane, Reishi and
Cordyceps — producing water-dispersible, clear-in-solution mushroom ingredients for
beverages. A daytime counterpart to kava, or stacked into the same line.

## Offerings and cost per serving

| Extract | Dose range | Cost / serving |
|---|---|---|
| Lion's Mane | 25–35 mg | $0.12–$0.17 |
| Cordyceps | 25–35 mg | $0.14–$0.20 |
| Reishi | 15–25 mg | $0.11–$0.19 |

Water-dispersible and clear in solution, on 50/50 USA/global sourcing. Cannasol was
first in the world to nano-emulsify reishi.

## Why nanoemulsified mushrooms

- **Faster absorption pathways** — nanoemulsification helps enable faster uptake and a
  more consistent consumer experience.
- **Formulation-friendly** — designed to integrate smoothly in water-based formulations
  with consistent dispersion.
- **Production-ready stability** — optimized for reliable batch-to-batch performance and
  scalable manufacturing workflows.

## Quality and documentation

A Certificate of Analysis (COA) and a particle-size report are supplied with every lot,
the same as the kava nanoemulsion.
